**Finding: deviation (WARRANTY)**

- **What the document has:** Section 9 ("TRUELINK WARRANTIES", p0059–p0060) is a Year 2000 warranty only. Section 3's hosting obligations are "reasonable commercial efforts" undertakings (response time, bandwidth, availability), and §3(i) expressly disclaims any warranty as to transmitted data. Nowhere does TrueLink warrant workmanlike performance, conformance of the Interface to documentation, absence of malicious code, or compliance with law — and there is no repair/re-perform/refund remedy.
- **Why it fails:** This is below even the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with remedies); effectively the Interface is provided with no conformance warranty.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** New warranty paragraph inserted after p0060 covering (i) professional and workmanlike services, (ii) 12-month conformance to documentation, (iii) no malicious code, (iv) compliance with laws, plus a re-performance/repair/replacement/refund remedy. Fallback periods (90/30 days) offered in the comment.
- **Not flagged:** The disclaimer at p0076 already opens with "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT", so it does not swallow the express warranty and needs no edit.
